title: Studio: read-only packages accept edit gestures client-side, fail only at server write
body:
Mirror of framework#2615 (P1), found by the Studio package-create UX dogfood (framework#2609, audit doc `docs/audits/2026-07-studio-package-create-ux-dogfood.md`). Reproduced against the pinned console build `7782698` at `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data` (source-loaded, Read-only badge shown).

## What happens

On a **read-only** package:

- **"+ Add field" actually mutates the canvas** — header count goes 16 → 17 fields and the Field properties panel opens on the new `field_17`.
- **"New object"** opens the inline create form and lets the user fill it out.
- "Save draft" / "Publish" remain visible (Publish styled enabled).

Only when the eventual server write fires does the user learn the whole edit was futile — a 422 `writable_package_required` toast (whose copy is being fixed framework-side in framework#2625).

## Expected

Client-side courtesy gating per ADR-0057 D10: when the active package is read-only, disable/hide `Add field`, `New object`, `Save draft`, `Publish`, and field-property inputs, with a tooltip like *"Read-only package — create or switch to a writable package to edit"*. The server remains the authoritative gate; the client just shouldn't let users build up doomed local state.

## Notes

- The read-only signal is already available to the client — the package switcher and Studio landing both badge Read-only correctly.
- Related polish: the read-only toast can fire twice for a single gesture.
